title: [Shopify] Add Unlisted to Status for Created Products and update status tooltip
summary: Shopify integration now supports Unlisted status when creating products and displays it in the status field tooltip. An Unlisted value was added to the product status enum with a new codeunit implementing the creation status interface.
key_points: Added Unlisted value to the status picker for new product creation on Shop Card
Updated Status field tooltip to include Unlisted alongside Active, Archived, and Draft
Created new codeunit implementing ICreateProductStatusValue interface for Unlisted status
Registered new functionality in Shopify Objects permission set
